description: Group contract form, page 1: each row label (PERSON AUTHORIZED TO SIGN CONTRACT *, NAME *) spans the rows of its fields, so no field row has an empty cell where the label stands. A field whose tooltip joins the author's field-name parts with '_' ('..._Row', 'Phone_Best way to contact you:') is named by the caption printed in the cell over it; the tooltip stays its title (#164).
